selection_process: The selection process for Goa Shipyard Limited Expert and Specialist Recruitment 2026 involves screening of applications based on the prescribed eligibility and experience requirements
followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.

GSL management may apply additional shortlisting criteria depending on the number and quality of applications received. Interviews may be conducted through video conferencing or in person. Interview call letters will be sent to shortlisted candidates through their registered email addresses.

No travelling allowance or daily allowance will be paid to candidates attending a personal interview. The notification does not prescribe a written examination for these contractual Expert and Specialist positions.
how_to_apply: Eligible candidates must complete the prescribed application form available with the official notification and submit it along with supporting documents to Goa Shipyard Limited. The application must reach the General Manager (HR&A) by 12 November 2026.
Visit the official website at www.goashipyard.in.
Navigate to Notice Board, Careers and Advertisement.
Locate Advertisement No. 08/2026 for the engagement of Experts / Specialists on contract basis.
Download the official notification and prescribed application form.
Fill in the post name, personal details, contact information, educational qualifications and professional experience.
Attach a recent photograph and provide the required references and employment details.
Enclose the supporting documents for age, qualifications and experience.
Sign the application form and declaration.
Send the completed form and documents to the prescribed address so that they reach by 12 November 2026.
General Manager (HR&A), Goa Shipyard Limited, Vaddem, Vasco-da-Gama, Goa - 403802.

Candidates applying for more than one position must submit separate applications for each post. Applications containing false or incorrect information may be rejected, and selection may be cancelled if discrepancies are discovered later.

content_sections.heading: Goa Shipyard Limited Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the educational qualifications and professional experience prescribed for the relevant Expert or Specialist position. Eligibility is determined based on the candidate's qualifications, overall service and relevant work experience. For positions 1 to 8, candidates must have completed at least 15 years of overall service, including a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in the concerned field. For the HR/IR Expert position, candidates must have at least 25 years of overall service, including 10 years of relevant experience. Relevant experience includes naval equipment maintenance, shipbuilding, ship repair, HVAC systems, gas turbines, dockyard operations, ship lift systems and industrial relations, depending on the position. The HR/IR role requires experience in unions, industrial relations and wage or pay revision matters, including senior-level experience.

Diploma in Electrical or Electronics Engineering or equivalent
Diploma in Engineering or equivalent, or specified MCPO I/MCPO II equivalent naval or Coast Guard service qualification

content_sections.heading: Goa Shipyard Limited Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for Goa Shipyard Limited Expert Recruitment 2026 is 63 years for positions 1 to 8 and 67 years for the HR/IR Expert position. Age and experience are calculated as on 30 September 2026. The notification does not specify a separate minimum age limit or category-wise age relaxation table for these contractual positions.

content_sections.heading: Goa Shipyard Limited Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Goa Shipyard Limited has not announced a fixed salary amount for the Expert and Specialist positions. Selected candidates will receive consolidated monthly remuneration negotiated during the selection process. The Selection Committee will determine the remuneration after considering the candidate's equivalent government pay, job profile, educational qualification, nature and duration of experience, and previous employment cost-to-company (CTC).

content_sections.heading: Goa Shipyard Limited Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process for Goa Shipyard Limited Expert and Specialist Recruitment 2026 involves screening of applications based on the prescribed eligibility and experience requirements, followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates. GSL management may apply additional shortlisting criteria depending on the number and quality of applications received. Interviews may be conducted through video conferencing or in person. Interview call letters will be sent to shortlisted candidates through their registered email addresses. No travelling allowance or daily allowance will be paid to candidates attending a personal interview. The notification does not prescribe a written examination for these contractual Expert and Specialist positions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Goa Shipyard Limited Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must complete the prescribed application form available with the official notification and submit it along with supporting documents to Goa Shipyard Limited. The application must reach the General Manager (HR&A) by 12 November 2026. General Manager (HR&A), Goa Shipyard Limited, Vaddem, Vasco-da-Gama, Goa - 403802. Candidates applying for more than one position must submit separate applications for each post. Applications containing false or incorrect information may be rejected, and selection may be cancelled if discrepancies are discovered later.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Goa Shipyard Limited (GSL) for various expert and specialist positions on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in GSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 14 vacancies advertised for various Expert and Specialist posts across different departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for GSL jobs?
faq.answer: The mode of application is offline. Candidates must fill out the prescribed form and send it by post to the designated address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for GSL Expert / Specialist posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post, ranging from Diplomas in relevant engineering streams, Apprenticeships, to Graduation degrees for HR/IR roles.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Sr. No 1 to 8 posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for posts at Serial Numbers 1 to 8 is 63 years as on 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for the HR/IR Specialist post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Expert/Specialist (HR/IR) post at Serial Number 9 is 67 years.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises screening of applications followed by an interview, which may be conducted via video conferencing or in person.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form must be sent by post to the General Manager (HR&A), Goa Shipyard Limited, Vasco-Da-Gama, Goa – 403802.

faq.question: Q10. What are the salary terms for these positions?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated emoluments are negotiable and will be decided by the Selection Committee based on candidate profiles.
